site: Three months earlier · Qingyu harbour shallows
black: Control to R-1. We train in the harbour today — no trip outside.
establish: Transom clear. I have the tether. Ease it out.
unlock: R-1, slack water in the harbour. Arm up. I'll fly with you.
approach: Pile 2 is dead ahead. Ease forward until it fills the frame.
descend: Crab pot by the pile foot. Descend until it is centred.
coast: Hands off. Slack still has a little set — watch if you drift toward the pile.
hold: R-1, you are drifting. Engage depth hold, then trim back.
trim: Remember that. Steady depth first, then frame.
A: Pile 2 number plate. Close in, frame and shoot.
B: Plenty of tether. Turn to the crab pot — get the mouth clear.
C: Last shot: the pontoon chain shackle. Then I'll reel in.
again: R-1, copy? Take that last step at your pace.
report: Logged {n}/3 usable photos. Remember your framing distance.
miss: Logged for practice. Move to the next station.
